$comment: Frozen oracle for SCN-SET-009. The sentinel is test data for a local stub provider; it is not an authentication credential for UAR. Truth source: this file and the existing requirements 'Sensitive setting masks preserve secret length' and 'Unchanged nested credential masks are non-destructive' in openspec/specs/frontend-configuration-surfaces.

provider.fieldChangedWithMaskUnchanged: default_model changed to a second model id served by the stub; the api_key field is submitted as the unchanged mask returned by the previous read

maskRule: every returned character of a stored secret is one mask character and the length equals the stored secret length (existing requirement)
logSource: stdout and stderr of the scratch instance plus its log file, captured from process start to stop

retentionOracle.observation: the Authorization header the stub-llm received on the provider test request after a save that submitted the unchanged mask
retentionOracle.requires: stub-llm records request Authorization headers and serves them on GET /__recorded-auth (task 1.8)

replacementOracle.observation: recorded Authorization header after saving replacementApiKey

driftProbe.procedure: PUT driftSentinel through the settings API, restart, GET /api/uar/settings/drift
driftProbe.expected: if the key appears in the drift list, neither data nor config_value contains driftSentinel; every character is a mask character; if it does not appear, the scenario records NOT_EXERCISED for this probe and falls back to 'GET /api/uar/settings/mistral_ocr.api_key' masking only

negativeControl.source: preserve_masked_sensitive_value returns NotFound when a placeholder is submitted for a missing row (src/uar/api/settings.rs:1523-1526)
